full_judgment: 4. Under section 2(16) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act land includes "houses or buildings and also things attached to the earth". In view of the same there should not be any difficulty to give delivery of possession to the decree-holder-opposite party in the decretal land even if it is found that petitioner has raised some structures on the said land. However, structure standing in the said 10 decimals of decretal land having not been decreed in favour of the decree-holder-opposite party, judgment-debtor petitioner is at liberty to remove the same before the delivery of possession. Otherwise the same will go with decretal land.
